role: Hand-maintained Swift API reference for the Emuqu iOS app: lists types, properties and method signatures per layer (models, collection, analysis, services, storage, import/export, protocols, view models, views, constants, AI assistant, fitness/routes additions).
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Code blocks are illustrative signatures, not compiled.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference
units.does: Title plus two notes: sleep domain types (SleepData, SleepStage, SleepStageInterval, SleepStageProvenance, SleepSegment, HRSleepQuality, SleepBoundarySource, SleepBoundaryValidation) are top-level in Models/SleepDomain.swift so Analysis/ signatures do not name the HealthKit I/O class, with HealthKitManager typealiases and the bare name preferred in new code; every observable type is @Observable, none ObservableObject, nothing @Published; RRCollector forwards to five sub-objects; async means the call can suspend, not that it runs in the background: an async method on a @MainActor type runs its synchronous body on the main actor, and work moved off is done explicitly with Task.detached or a nonisolated function; errors typed from Errors.swift. Typealiases at Emuqu/Sources/Collection/HealthKitManager.swift; Errors.swift at Emuqu/Sources/Utilities/Errors.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Table of Contents
units.does: no behavioural claim: table of contents listing 11 top-level sections (later sections Notifications..WorkoutMetadata under AI Assistant heading level are not listed separately).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Data Models > HRV Metrics

Lists HRVAnalysisResult.estimatedMetrics (EstimatedMetric raw names an importer filled without a measurement; display marks them, aggregates leave them out) with its readers isEstimated/measuredSDNN/measuredPNN50/measured(_:as:)/markingEstimate, and the EstimatedMetric enum.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Collection Layer > RRCollector (Main Orchestrator)
units.does: RRCollector @MainActor @Observable orchestrator: lists ~20 observable state properties and the public API for hybrid overnight streaming, pause/resume/finalize split sleep (resume links the parent's archived copy in place and, like startOvernightStreaming, throws alreadyRecording while a night is being ended via refuseWhileEndingInProgress; finalizeFromPause marks the archive's copy complete in place, publishes it and requests a re-upload; findRecentPausedSessionOffMain skips a paused session an archived segment was resumed from), quick streaming (default 180 s; refused while a night is paused or being ended, requireConnectedWithNoNightHeld), device-only recording, accept/reject/reset, notifyArchiveChanged and adoptArchivedCopy, session loading (recentSessionsAsync, retrieveFullSessionAsync), import, backup recovery (recoverFromBackup with optional recordedType, deleteLostSessions returning the ids whose mark was stored, permanentlyDelete returning a TrashDeletionOutcome) and training context (forwarded to the SessionScoringContext). Reanalysis is SessionReanalysisCoordinator's. Every listed method exists as an RRCollector facade/forwarder (RRCollector.swift, +*Forwarding.swift, +Acceptance.swift, +PauseResume.swift, +Session.swift).

All exist with those signatures.

Matches the listing.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > Watch / HR-based sleep estimation
units.does: States there is no WatchSleepDetector; sleep is estimated from HR by two sibling heuristics sharing adaptive threshold = midpoint of HR range: estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR(windowStart, windowEnd, minimumSamples 12, minimumSleepMinutes 120) for passive Watch HR, and static estimateSleepFromHR(rrPoints, recordingStart) for the RR series. Threshold confirmed maxHR-(max-min)*0.5 with an 8 bpm minimum range (HRSleepEstimator.swift); defaults 12/120 confirmed (HealthKitManager+Sleep.swift). No WatchSleepDetector type exists.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > TimeDomainAnalyzer
units.does: TimeDomainAnalyzer.computeTimeDomain(series, flags, windowStart, windowEnd) -> TimeDomainMetrics?, requiring >= 10 clean RR intervals. Confirmed TimeDomainAnalysis.swift (guard cleanRR.count >= 10). Enum also exposes rmssd overloads, peakScanRMSSD, ectopic filters not listed.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > FrequencyDomainAnalyzer
units.does: FrequencyDomainAnalyzer: computeFrequencyDomain, computeFromCleanPairs (used by HRVSleepStageClassifier), computePSD(signal, fs, segmentLength, usableWindowMin), getDFTSetup, teardownDFTCache; Welch 256-sample segments (1024 for VLF), linear detrend, 50% overlap, Hann, 4 Hz resampling; VLF needs >= 10 min. Confirmed FrequencyDomainAnalysis.swift (segment lengths 119/124, Hann at 269, detrend at 316, resampleFrequency 4.0, vlfMinDuration = 5*2).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > NonlinearAnalyzer
units.does: NonlinearAnalyzer.computeNonlinear: Poincare SD1/SD2, Sample Entropy (m=2, r=0.2*SD), Approximate Entropy, DFA; none treats a removed beat or a recording break as adjacency: SD1 = sqrt(½·Var) of TimeDomainAnalyzer.successiveDifferences(in:) (SD1 tracks SDSD/√2), SD2 by Brennan's identity over all clean beats, entropy templates inside runs of neighbours, DFA via DFAAnalyzer.compute(window:); window from TimeDomainAnalyzer.cleanWindow (CleanBeatWindow); nil below 10 clean beats or with no adjacent pair; a gap-free window gives the single-series values. Confirmed NonlinearAnalysis.swift and TimeDomainAnalysis.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > DFAAnalyzer
units.does: DFAAnalyzer.compute(rr, alpha1Range 4...16, alpha2Range 16...64) -> DFAResult(alpha1, alpha2?, alpha1R2, alpha2R2?), requires >= 64 beats, log-spaced box sizes (Peng 1995); compute(window:) = compute(segments: interpolatedSegments(window)); compute(segments:) uses one profile, no box spanning two segments, boxes up to 1/4 of the longest segment, one segment == compute(_:); interpolatedSegments splits at breaks and linearly interpolates removed beats (Kubios; Lipponen & Tarvainen 2019), no extrapolation. Confirmed DFAAnalysis.swift and Constants.swift.

units.does: StressAnalyzer: computeStressIndex, computePNSIndex(meanRR, rmssd, sd1), computeSNSIndex(meanHR, stressIndex, sd2), computeReadinessScore(rmssd, baselineRMSSD, alpha1, pns, sns, trainingLoadAdjustment, vo2Max) -> 1-10. Confirmed StressAnalysis.swift (clamped max(1, min(10, score))).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > RespirationAnalyzer
units.does: Documents RespirationAnalyzer.estimateRespirationRate(_:fs:) (default fs 4.0): needs ≥ 60 RR intervals and an HF peak that is breathing rather than noise or leakage (isBreathingPeak), nil otherwise; 6-40 breaths/min sanity check. Matches the code.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > RecoveryScoreCalculator
units.does: RecoveryScoreCalculator: composite is HRV+Sleep+Vitals 60/25/15 (training load not in the composite; trainingMetrics/trainingContext stay on the API for caller stability but are not consumed by the score); Comeback mode 80/20/0; ScoringConfiguration with init(from:) and memberwise init; ScoreBreakdown (0-100 composite, tier 1/2/3, factors HRV/Sleep/Vitals, penalties only SpO2 -10 if <95% with RR and temperature feeding the Vitals sub-score, scoringVersion v3.3.nov2026 or 'unversioned' when decoded, unstored refreshedFactorShift from a display-time vitals refresh taken out of the factor/composite gap); ScoreFactor with Impact String Codable decoding an unknown impact as .neutral; ScoringParameters V1/V2, default V2; ScoreInputs; two calculateWithBreakdown overloads (TrainingContext overload: useBaselineHRV substitutes baseline, perceivedReadiness 0-1 clamped blended 30% with 70% baseline HRV factor); calculateVitalsScore (nil without vitals so the caller falls back to Tier 2); zToRecoveryScore; calculateTier1 (without baseline stats a reading with RMSSD uses the absolute RMSSD bands; readiness 1-10 → 10-100 only with no usable RMSSD, else 50); calculateSleepScore; fosterMonotonyStrain; zToPercentileScore. Code: RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift (ScoreBreakdown, Impact.init(from:)), +Tiers.swift (calculateTier1), VitalsScoring.swift (refreshedFactorShift), ScoringVersion.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > ReadinessScoring

Implemented in enum ReadinessScoring with RecoveryScoreCalculator forwarders (RecoveryScoreCalculator+ReadinessForwarding.swift); returns 50 for non-finite and clamps 0-100.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Storage > RawRRBackup

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > AI Assistant

Confirmed AssistantContext.swift; ContextBuilder.swift; AssistantContextSource.swift (serial DispatchQueue, live training load and baseline tracker captured on MainActor first, live workout/HRV overlays applied after build).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > AI Assistant > Routing infrastructure
units.does: Routing: modes act only while Apple is selected; otherwise or in Manual every turn goes to the selected model (TurnRouter.preTierDecision). With Apple selected, voice turns go to the first consented cloud provider; Quick -> Apple; Auto -> CapabilityClassifier tier with mid tier = consented Grok then DeepSeek (Apple if neither); Deep with Apple primary -> same mid-tier cloud. failureFallback: Auto/Deep .anyAccepted, Quick .onDeviceOnly, Manual or selected cloud .none (PickedModelFailure). SmartProviderRouter singleton (Tier quick=1/auto/deep, route, daily Tier-3 cap 50, embed in one vector space per launch; no telemetry counters); RoutingSessionState; TierProviderMapper.mapping.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Services > PurgeGate

Prose: DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData refuses while recording, beginPurge with defer endPurge, turns iCloud Sync off, awaits the remote delete, re-checks recording (Refusal.recordingStartedDuringDelete: no local wipe, sync stays off) before the wipe; a rescore finishing during or after a purge writes nothing (RescoreWrite .notArchived).
